title: yeasty crunchy polish green pepper quesadilla
description: a romantic polish-inspired dish featuring a yeasty and crunchy green pepper filling wrapped in a warm tortilla, flambe for added flavor. perfect for a date night in.
instructions: in a small bowl combine yeast and warm water and stir to dissolve. let sit for 5 minutes until frothy.
in a large bowl whisk together flour and salt. add in melted butter and mix until crumbly.
add in shredded cheese, green pepper, egg, and heavy cream. mix until a dough forms.
knead the dough for 5 minutes until smooth. place in a greased bowl and cover with plastic wrap.
let the dough rise in a warm place for 1 hour, or until doubled in size.
preheat the oven to 4005f (2005c). punch down the dough and divide into 4 equal pieces.
roll out each piece into a thin circle. place 1 tablespoon of butter in the center of each circle. sprinkle with cheese, green pepper, and garlic.
fold the dough in half to enclose the filling. press the edges together to seal.
heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. add a tortilla and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until crispy and golden.
flambe with 1 tablespoon of butter for added flavor.
repeat with remaining tortillas and filling. cut into wedges and serve immediately.
cook time can be reduced by cooking the quesadillas in the oven instead of on the stovetop. place on a baking sheet and bake at 4005f (2005c) for 10-12 minutes, or until crispy and golden.
serve with sour cream or applesauce for a tangy contrast.
you can also add some diced ham or bacon for added protein.
